hook: Jared Kaplan built his early career as a theoretical physicist, holding a PhD from Harvard and a faculty position at Johns Hopkins studying quantum gravity and conformal field theory. Starting in 2018 he turned that background toward machine learning, working on how language model performance scales with compute, data and parameters, research his own university describes as feeding into GPT-3. In 2021 he co-founded Anthropic and became its Chief Science Officer, leading the technical research behind models like Claude and methods such as Constitutional AI. He still holds his Johns Hopkins physics appointment alongside his role at Anthropic.

standing.watch: The records leave several matters unresolved. The lawsuits against Anthropic PBC are mostly at the filed stage, with docket monitoring active and no development recorded yet by this tracker. Brunell v. Anthropic PBC has federal docket activity in August and September 2026, including motions on default judgment and extension of time and a response to motion, but the records do not state an outcome beyond those entries. The site's company entries for Anthropic list no funding or valuation figures, so the records do not show a planned listing or financing event. For Kaplan himself, the records show no pending case naming him personally and no next step beyond his continued roles at Anthropic and Johns Hopkins. What comes next, according to these records, is further docket monitoring in the Anthropic cases and any development in the Brunell matter.
standing.record: The site's records for Jared Kaplan center on Anthropic, which appears twice, once as a company he founded and once as a company where he is an executive. The lawsuits on the site all name Anthropic PBC, not Kaplan personally, and include Buist v. Anthropic, PBC, JIANG v. ANTHROPIC PBC, Brandon Grossinger v. Anthropic PBC is the exception in the records, as it was removed from Vermont Superior Court to D. Vt. on August 14, 2026, with the state court record docketed in the federal case in August 2026, motions on default judgment and extension of time resolved on August 25, and a response to motion filed September 2, 2026. The pattern in these records is a co-founder and scientific leader whose public footprint on the site is tied to Anthropic's research identity and to litigation against the company rather than to him as an individual defendant.
standing.standing: The records place Jared Kaplan as co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Anthropic, leading its technical research. He also holds an associate professorship at Johns Hopkins University's Department of Physics and Astronomy, researching quantum gravity, conformal field theory and machine learning. He holds a PhD in theoretical physics from Harvard University. The records say he began collaborating on machine learning research in 2018, work tied to neural scaling laws and GPT-3. He co-founded Anthropic in 2021 alongside Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Tom Brown, Jack Clark, Sam McCandlish and Chris Olah. The site lists Anthropic as a startup in San Francisco, founded 2021, with him as founder and executive.
